title: fraxinus americana var. alba
intro: Fraxinus americana var. alba, commonly known as white ash, is a deciduous tree belonging to the family Oleaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of white ash include its ability to relax muscles, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of white ash include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
